newsitem.title: USA: Monro Muffler Q1 hurt by weather.
newsitem.headline: Monro Muffler Q1 hurt by weather.

text.p: Monro Muffler Brake Inc said on Wednesday that it expects first quarter earnings per share to be in the $0.39 to $0.42 range, compared with $3.4 million or $0.42 a share, due to poor weather in April and May.
For the first quarter ending June 30, 1997, it expects sales of $40.1 million to $40.7 million.
Monro reported sales of $37.7 million in last year's first quarter.
Analysts that follow Monro had expected the company to report earnings of $0.48 a share, according to First Call's consensus of earnings estimates.

In recent weeks, Monro said it has experienced a slight increase in consumer activity as the weather improved in June and that it is on schedule to open 40 to 50 stores during the current fiscal year.
Sales for new stores opened in fiscal year 1997 continue to exceed initial expectations, Monro said.
